title: Which chat bot setup works for a growing Twitch channel?
body: As a channel grows, chat moves faster than a streamer or one moderator can handle. Do you run a hosted bot, a platform-integrated one or something self-hosted, and what rules do you automate?

The [Nightbot documentation](https://docs.nightbot.tv) describes a chat bot for Twitch, YouTube and SOOP that automates live chat moderation, with sections on commands, variables, spam protection and a Discord integration. The [StreamElements homepage](https://streamelements.com/) lists overlays, tipping, chatbot, alerts and merchandise among its features.
Share your moderation approach (strict filters, human moderators or both), which commands you actually use and what you stopped automating because viewers disliked it.
